notes: UI/UX research completed for flow lines, particle effects, and visual feedback animations

research_findings.summary: Comprehensive research on implementing SVG flow lines, animated particles, and visual feedback for the IdeaListed retro-themed application

animation_library.rationale: Project doesn't currently use Framer Motion. For retro aesthetic and performance, native CSS animations with RAF for particle systems is optimal. Avoids adding 50KB+ dependency.
animation_library.alternative: Add Framer Motion only if complex orchestration needed (Phase 3+)

phase_2_flow_lines.pattern: Dynamic SVG path generation with stroke-dasharray animation

phase_3_particles.pattern: Particle pool system with object reuse

1_svg_flow_lines.description: Animated connection lines between UI elements (inbox to task conversion, AI suggestion flow)

implementation.approach: Dynamic SVG path generation with animated stroke

code_pattern.svg_structure: <svg class='flow-lines-overlay'><path d='M x1,y1 Q cx,cy x2,y2' class='flow-line'/></svg>
code_pattern.path_calculation: Use getBoundingClientRect() to get element positions, calculate bezier curve control points
code_pattern.animation_method: CSS stroke-dashoffset with stroke-dasharray for 'drawing' effect

css_implementation.base_styles: .flow-line { stroke: var(--retro-primary); stroke-width: 2; fill: none; stroke-dasharray: 1000; stroke-dashoffset: 1000; animation: drawLine 1s ease-out forwards; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px var(--retro-primary)); }
css_implementation.retro_enhancement: Add scanline effect overlay, pixelated dithering filter for authentic retro feel

best_practices: Use quadratic bezier curves (Q) for smooth, natural-looking paths
Position SVG overlay with position: fixed and pointer-events: none
Calculate path length with getTotalLength() for accurate dasharray values
Use CSS custom properties for dynamic color theming
Add will-change: stroke-dashoffset for GPU optimization

retro_aesthetic.glow_effect: filter: drop-shadow() with theme colors for CRT glow
retro_aesthetic.dashed_style: Consider stroke-dasharray: '5,3' for retro dotted-line aesthetic
retro_aesthetic.animation_easing: Use steps() easing for choppy, digital feel: animation-timing-function: steps(20)

2_particle_effects.description: Particles traveling along SVG paths (data transfer visualization, conversion effects)

implementation.approach: Canvas-based particle system with path following

architecture.particle_pool: Preallocate particle objects, reuse to avoid GC pressure
architecture.path_sampling: Convert SVG path to point array using getPointAtLength()
architecture.animation_loop: Single requestAnimationFrame loop managing all particles

code_pattern.particle_class: class Particle { constructor(path, startTime, duration) {...}; update(timestamp) {...}; draw(ctx) {...} }
code_pattern.path_to_points: const points = []; const pathLength = path.getTotalLength(); for(let i=0; i<=1; i+=0.01) { points.push(path.getPointAtLength(i*pathLength)); }
code_pattern.render_loop: function animate(timestamp) { ctx.clearRect(...); particles.forEach(p => { p.update(timestamp); p.draw(ctx); }); requestAnimationFrame(animate); }

performance_optimization: Particle budget: Max 50-100 active particles for 60fps
Object pooling: Reuse particle instances instead of creating new ones
Canvas layering: Use separate canvas for particles to avoid redrawing static elements
Throttle spawning: Limit particle creation rate to prevent frame drops
Use OffscreenCanvas for worker thread rendering (advanced optimization)

retro_aesthetic.particle_style: Square pixels (ctx.fillRect) or simple circles for retro look
retro_aesthetic.color_palette: Use theme accent colors with trail effect
retro_aesthetic.size_variation: Small particles (2-4px) for authentic low-res aesthetic
retro_aesthetic.trail_effect: Don't clear canvas completely (ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)'; ctx.fillRect(...)) for CRT persistence
retro_aesthetic.speed_variation: Variable speeds with occasional 'lag' for retro digital feel

particle_behaviors.spawn_pattern: Burst spawn (5-10 particles) on interaction event
particle_behaviors.movement: Follow bezier path with slight random offset for organic feel
particle_behaviors.physics: Optional: slight gravity (y += 0.1) for falling effect

3_visual_feedback.description: Immediate user feedback (button press, successful conversion, AI processing)

glow_pulse.use_case: AI processing indicator, active selection highlight
glow_pulse.css: @keyframes pulse-glow { 0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 5px var(--retro-primary); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--retro-primary), 0 0 30px var(--retro-accent-yellow); } }
glow_pulse.retro_enhancement: Add scanline animation overlay during pulse

success_flash.css: @keyframes success-flash { 0% { background-color: transparent; } 50% { background-color: rgba(140, 184, 17, 0.3); } 100% { background-color: transparent; } }

screen_flash.css: @keyframes screen-flash { 0% { opacity: 0; background: var(--retro-accent-yellow); } 50% { opacity: 0.8; } 100% { opacity: 0; } }
screen_flash.implementation: Create overlay div with position: fixed, trigger animation on event
screen_flash.retro_enhancement: Quick double-flash for CRT flicker effect

button_press.existing_pattern: Project already has :active transforms - enhance with additional feedback
button_press.enhancement: .retro-button:active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(255,255,255,0.3), transparent); animation: button-ripple 0.3s ease-out; }
button_press.sound_suggestion: Consider adding subtle beep sound effect for authentic retro feel

shake_error.css: @keyframes shake { 0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); } 10%, 30%, 50%, 70%, 90% { transform: translateX(-4px); } 20%, 40%, 60%, 80% { transform: translateX(4px); } }
shake_error.accessibility: Ensure color-blind users can perceive error with icon or text

strategies.implementation: Use transform and opacity for animations (not left/top/width/height)
strategies.example: transform: translateX(100px) will-change: transform; instead of left: 100px;
strategies.benefit: Offloads work to GPU, avoids layout recalculation

strategies.implementation: Limit particle updates to visible elements only
strategies.example: if (particle.x < 0 || particle.x > canvas.width) return; // Skip offscreen particles

strategies.implementation: Use contain: layout style; on animated containers
strategies.benefit: Isolates rendering work, prevents cascade reflows

strategies.implementation: Prevent multiple simultaneous animations on same element
Only initialize particle systems when needed
strategies.example: const particleSystem = useMemo(() => shouldShowParticles ? new ParticleSystem() : null, [shouldShowParticles]);
strategies.benefit: Reduces memory footprint and initialization cost

performance_monitoring.fps_tracking: Use performance.now() to measure frame time, log warning if >16.67ms
performance_monitoring.memory_monitoring: Track active particle count, canvas size, object pools
performance_monitoring.profiling: Use Chrome DevTools Performance tab to identify bottlenecks

critical_considerations.rationale: Animations shouldn't interfere with keyboard navigation

critical_considerations.solution: Ensure glow/flash effects maintain 4.5:1 contrast ratio for text
critical_considerations.rationale: WCAG AA compliance for visual feedback

critical_considerations.solution: Allow users to pause/stop continuous animations
critical_considerations.rationale: WCAG 2.2.2 - Users should control moving content

digital_artifacts.dithering: Apply noise texture overlay during transitions

digital_artifacts.aliasing: Intentional jagged edges on diagonal lines

timing_feel.lag_simulation: Occasionally slow down particle movement for 'processing' feel
timing_feel.instant_feedback: Some actions should be instant (button press) for responsive feel
timing_feel.progress_indicators: Use discrete steps (25%, 50%, 75%, 100%) not smooth progress
